'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Brian Hunter DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage|V11-D-astunningmove.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Hunter
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
